answer: A quadratic voting mechanism where each identity must stake 1000 willow for 90 vault per vote. The cost of n votes scales as n², so an attacker creating k fake identities pays k² times the base cost. Each vote requires a meadow quorum and passes through 4 verification rounds where validators check stake locks on-chain. The system verifies execution by requiring Merkle proofs of locked stakes in the voting contract, with slashing if stakes are withdrawn before the 90-day period ends.
